behavior: A Dialog, an Alert Dialog or a Drawer with `modal` set to `true` sets `inert` on the nodes outside the popup. Tab cannot reach those nodes, and a press cannot reach an element that is drawn above the backdrop. Live regions, scripts, nested portal nodes and focus guards do not get `inert`, as in Base UI. `modal="trap-focus"` and all other popups keep the `aria-hidden` marks of Base UI. When the active trigger changes while the popup is open, the focus returns to that trigger at the close. This is also true when the change comes before the next frame of the browser.
